rationale: Restricted DIIS packing preserves the CC equations and materially lowers history capacity, but changes FP64 projection/summation order and has no demonstrated complete wall-time benefit. Its retained value is capacity admission, not latency.
revisit_condition: Normal latency execution should keep full histories. Automatic packing may be promoted only as an identity-checked resource-budget fallback that proves the full-history route would exceed the admitted budget and preserves the existing symmetry, replay and numerical gates.
